scripts.dev: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.preview: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.build:pages: mkdir -p dist && cp -f index.html dist/index.html && echo "{\"version\": 1, \"include\": [\"/*\"], \"exclude\": []}" > dist/_routes.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/_worker.js
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ai-gateway
